title: rubus obtruncatus subsp. pilocarpus
intro: Rubus obtruncatus subsp. pilocarpus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a subspecies of the raspberry plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to treat various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rubus obtruncatus subsp. pilocarpus include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
